findings.desc: CHK-002 adversarial evidence is not credible at packages/main/src/core/autopilot-policy.ts:408-422. Those lines reject unbounded full-autopilot policies, but packages/main/src/tasks/autopilot-run-smoke.ts:347-365 only asserts successful creation of a bounded policy and never exercises the refusal cases. The checklist evidence note pointing to build/smoke therefore overclaims coverage for missing maxIterations/maxRuntimeMinutes/maxBudgetUSD/stop flags.

CHK-007 edge intent is unmet at packages/main/src/core/lattice-autopilot.ts:625-748. The implementation has no bounded retry path tied to allowAutoFix after validation failure, and packages/main/src/tasks/autopilot-run-smoke.ts:493-519 only covers a successful full-autopilot run plus a maxIterations stop. The recorded evidence maps this must-have retry intent to max_iterations, which is a different behavior.

CHK-008 edge evidence relies on docs instead of an executable conflict-path check. packages/main/src/core/lattice-autopilot.ts:522-527 and 728-738 classify conflict/validation stop behavior, but packages/main/src/tasks/autopilot-run-smoke.ts:412-597 never drives a conflict case or verifies that evidence is preserved with a repair nextAction. README.md:240-245 is a boundary statement, not credible test coverage for this logic intent.

autopilot_run does not enforce the advertised two-policy autopilot contract. Docs and CLI say autopilot uses a dispatch policy plus an autopilot policy (README.md:200-225, host-overflow.md:72-94, cli-engine.ts:944-1009), but the persisted AutopilotPolicy shape has no dispatch/host/path/command fields (autopilot-policy.ts:116-162) and autopilotRun never loads or checks an autopilot policy before execution; it just forwards args.policy directly to dispatchAuto (lattice-autopilot.ts:538-555, 558-651). Runtime repro: in a temp repo, dispatch_policy_create followed by autopilot_run --policy=dispatch-only reached story lookup failure instead of rejecting missing autopilot policy. This collapses the dispatch/autopilot distinction and means Conservative / Authority-Verified / Full Autopilot semantics are not actually policy-authorized by the saved autopilot policy.
